email_body:
Dear Scrambly Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Account Manager role. Your mission to build a reward-powered alternative to traditional app stores caught my attention, and I'd love to contribute to your fast-growing, bootstrapped team.

In my current roles as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto and as a freelancer, I manage client relationships, optimize campaigns, and handle technical setups. I work daily with Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs to analyze data and improve performance. I've also built and optimized websites with structured data and tracking, giving me a solid foundation in mobile attribution and campaign tracking. My experience with WordPress, Shopify, and front-end development (AngularJS, JavaScript) means I can handle the technical side of campaign implementation.

I'm fluent in English, proactive, and eager to learn. I thrive in fast-paced environments and enjoy solving problems creatively. I'm confident that my analytical skills and entrepreneurial mindset align well with Scrambly's goals.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Scrambly Team,

I am excited to apply for the Account Manager position at Scrambly. Your innovative approach to app discovery through a reward-powered ecosystem, and your impressive growth as a bootstrapped startup, resonate with my own professional interests and aspirations.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage client accounts, optimize campaigns, and handle technical setups for WordPress and Shopify sites. I regularly analyze data using Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs to drive performance improvements. This hands-on experience has honed my ability to interpret data sets and make informed decisions to achieve KPIs. Additionally, my freelance work involves building and optimizing websites with structured data and tracking implementations, which has given me a solid understanding of mobile attribution and campaign tracking.

My technical background, including front-end development with AngularJS and JavaScript, enables me to communicate effectively with technical teams and ensure smooth campaign setups. I have a proven track record of building strong client relationships, identifying upsell opportunities, and delivering results. For example, at Episto, I contributed to growing organic traffic for client sites through targeted SEO strategies and content optimization.

I am fluent in English and possess strong sales and negotiation skills, which I have developed through client interactions and project management. I am proactive, autonomous, and thrive in fast-paced environments where continuous learning is essential. The opportunity to work with major gaming advertisers and to brainstorm new ideas aligns with my entrepreneurial mindset and drive for impact.

I am eager to bring my analytical skills, technical expertise, and client-focused approach to Scrambly. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team's success.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Client account management and campaign optimization at Episto, using Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs to track performance and achieve KPIs.
• Technical campaign setup and tracking implementation through freelance work, including structured data, JSON-LD schema, and website optimization.
• Strong analytical skills demonstrated by data-driven SEO and marketing strategies that improved search health scores and organic traffic.
• Front-end development experience (AngularJS, JavaScript) enabling effective communication with technical teams and smooth campaign implementation.
• Fluent English, proactive problem-solver with an entrepreneurial mindset, eager to learn and contribute in a fast-paced environment.
